releaseNotes:
## ✨ What's New

### 🧰 Find Tools Faster
- Search the tool gallery by name or description and filter tools by enabled or available status.
- Configure a Sage X3 tool preset using its service URL. Disabled session tools are now visible for discovery.
- See the selected view in the sidebar's More menu.

## 🛠️ Improvements
- The tool gallery installation dialog has been simplified.
- Nova CLI updates now run from Nova's installation directory.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
- Storage appears in the sidebar only in chat mode.
- Chat actions no longer overlap the mode controls.

## ⚙️ Under the Hood
- EV malware-scan validation during signing has been hardened.
- Application version metadata was bumped to 1.0.20.

🛸 Co-authored with [Nova](https://www.compassap.ai/portfolio/nova.html)
